About

Triple Threat Team

Triple Threat Team: Sierra Leonean Afro-trap and Salone pop, sung in Krio. Street anthems like “Gbet Pa D Boi” and “Ole Am Dae”, a tribute to football legend Mohamed Kallon, love songs like “Lover” and “Fatima”, and now the Affairs sessions. The studio is part of the story: the crew films how the songs get made.

Bio to be written with the artists and their team before anything goes live.
